findings.subject: button
findings.summary: A Button rendered as a link through `render` still navigates when disabled or loading, and gets type="button".
findings.fix: When the rendered element is not a <button>, set aria-disabled and block activation (preventDefault on click/Enter) instead of `disabled`, and omit `type`; or adopt Base UI's nativeButton/focusableWhenDisabled handling. Add a test with render={<a href>}.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: Starting the loading state disables the native button, so a keyboard user who pressed Save loses focus to <body>.
findings.fix: Keep loading buttons focusable: use aria-disabled plus a click guard (Base UI focusableWhenDisabled) for loading; keep native `disabled` for disabled only. Test that focus stays on the button after loading starts.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: In Aqua, icon-size Buttons set overflow: hidden, clipping the 44px touch target pseudo-element; icon buttons (and every default CopyButton) keep a 32px target on touch.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/button/button.css:131-136,159-161; --a63-control-min-target touch = 2.75rem, --a63-control-min-size touch = 2rem (`atom63 token`); craft/rules.ts target-size checks 24px only
findings.fix: Clip the reflection on ::after itself (border-radius: inherit, inset 0, or clip-path) instead of overflow on the root, and add a touch-input target check at 44px for aqua icon buttons.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: Hover and focus-visible are designed but no baseline captures them, for Button or any subject in this batch.
findings.fix: Add hover and focus-visible captures (pseudo-state or Playwright hover/Tab) to the States stories.

findings.subject: button
findings.summary: `render` composition (props spread, ref forwarding, slot attributes on the rendered element) has no test.
findings.fix: Add a test rendering Button through render={<a/>} and a ref, asserting class, data-* and ref land on the anchor.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: overflow-x: auto on a horizontal ButtonGroup clips member Buttons' 44px hit areas, so members keep ~32px targets on touch.
findings.fix: Grow the group's block padding (or member height) to --a63-control-min-target on touch inputs, or move scrolling to an inner wrapper with padding-block that contains the hit areas.

findings.subject: button-group
findings.summary: ButtonGroupProvider/useButtonGroupContext is exported but no component reads it; the docs say members flatten through it.
findings.evidence: packages/ui-react/src/components/button-group/button-group-context.tsx; grep useButtonGroupContext in packages/ui-react/src finds only re-exports
findings.fix: Either remove the context from the public API in the next breaking release or make the CLI text say flattening is CSS-only.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: The subtle tone shows pressed vs not-pressed by hue alone (1.46:1 between states).
findings.fix: Add a non-colour cue to subtle pressed (filled glyph, weight change, a soft fill or an indicator) so the states differ by at least 3:1 or by shape. Applies to ToggleGroup items with tone="subtle" too.

findings.subject: toggle
findings.summary: The CLI and docs guidance for Toggle is archetype boilerplate that mentions errors and invalid state, and there is no runnable example.
findings.fix: Write component-specific usage for Toggle (pressed vs Button, icon-only labelling, tone choice) with a runnable controlled example in the catalog entry, and stop emitting the generic form guidance for non-form controls.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: The contract's selectionMode axis does not exist in the React API, which uses Base UI's boolean `multiple`; ToggleGroup's size and tone props are not in its contract.
findings.fix: Either accept `selectionMode` in ToggleGroup and map it to `multiple`, or rename the contract axis to match the prop; add sizes and tones to toggle-group.json (or reference toggle's).

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: A ToggleGroup wider than the viewport overflows the page at phone width: no wrap, scroll or overflow handling.
findings.fix: Match ButtonGroup: max-width: 100% with horizontal scroll (and a visible edge affordance), or let pills wrap; add a 390px phone story.

findings.subject: toggle-group
findings.summary: The docs never show how to choose single vs multiple selection, and the guidance mentions errors and invalid state.
findings.evidence: `pnpm -s atom63 component toggle-group` (one tsx block: the import)
findings.fix: Add usage with a runnable single and multiple example (value/onValueChange, `multiple`) and component-specific guidance.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: User-facing copy is hard-coded English, and the default success toast reads 'Copy copied to clipboard'.
findings.fix: Default the success toast to 'Copied to clipboard' when no label is given, and expose the visible 'Copied!' text and the error message as props (or one `messages` prop).

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: The default CopyButton (icon-sm) loses its 44px touch target in Aqua (same root cause as r2-k01-actions-3).
findings.fix: Fixed by r2-k01-actions-3; add an aqua + touch CopyButton target assertion.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: The copied and copy-failed states have no baseline.
findings.evidence: apps/storybook/visual/__screenshots__/ui-react-copybutton-* (7 files, none in the copied state)
findings.fix: Add a story that renders CopyButtonFeedback copied={true} (icon and labelled) across themes and capture it.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: CopyButton docs are boilerplate (loading/disabled/destructive) with no runnable example of value, label and Toaster setup.
findings.fix: Write specific usage (value vs label, secrets and title, Toaster requirement, CopyButtonFeedback for custom flows) with a runnable example.

findings.subject: copy-button
findings.summary: In aqua dark, the secondary icon CopyButton's gloss dome washes over the top half of the glyph.
findings.fix: Reduce the dome height or opacity on small icon sizes, or raise glyph contrast on glossy secondary. YZ to confirm on the contact sheet.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: '(opens in new tab)' is hard-coded English with no way to localise it.
findings.fix: Add a `newTabLabel` prop (default '(opens in new tab)') used for both the sr-only text and the aria-label suffix.

findings.subject: destination-link
findings.summary: DestinationLink docs are boilerplate (loading, disabled, destructive) with no runnable router or external example.
findings.fix: Add usage with runnable internal (render={<RouterLink/>}) and external examples, and when to add DestinationIndicator.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: PanelSettingButton is a pressed control with a controlled-only `active` boolean and no change callback or uncontrolled default, unlike Toggle.
findings.fix: Add `pressed`/`defaultPressed`/`onPressedChange` (or build on Base UI Toggle), keeping `active` as a deprecated alias; fix the stale header comment about `tile`.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: The active tile's glyph is ~2.1:1 against its tile in every dark mode because it uses the fill token --a63-action-primary as foreground.
findings.fix: Use a foreground-role token (--a63-text-accent) for the active glyph so it holds at least 3:1 in both modes.

findings.subject: panel-setting-button
findings.summary: The docs give form-field boilerplate and never show wiring `active` to state.
findings.fix: Write specific usage with a runnable controlled example (useState + onClick, aria-hidden icon) and when to prefer ToggleGroup or SegmentedControl.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: KbdGroup renders a <div>, which is invalid inside a paragraph and raises React hydration errors in the sentence usage the docs promote.
findings.fix:
Render KbdGroup as (nested kbd is the HTML idiom for a key combination) or a , and put the InContext story inside a

.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: Kbd carries two baselined craft debts: a dark-mode branch and a surface token used as text colour for the in-tooltip keycap, which has no baseline.
findings.fix: Derive the in-tooltip keycap from the tooltip's own foreground (color: inherit; background: color-mix(in oklch, currentColor 15%, transparent)), delete the mode branch, drop both baseline entries, and capture a Kbd-in-Tooltip baseline in all themes.

findings.subject: kbd
findings.summary: Kbd docs are utility boilerplate (reduced motion) with no runnable example.
findings.fix: Add usage with a runnable inline example, symbol-key naming guidance and when to hide shortcuts on touch-only devices.
